title: An Act Regarding the Notification Process for Competitive Bids

summary.text: This bill amends the notice requirements to the public regarding state contracts and grants. The bill requires additional notice to the public when a state contract is renewed for a 3rd renewal period or when a contract with a total value greater than $1,000,000 is renewed.
